$seat..write: auth != null && root.child('games').child($code).child('players').child($seat).val() === auth.uid && !data.exists() && newData.child('uid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('word').isString() && newData.child('word').val().matches(/^[A-Z]{4,8}$/)
